 BassGaming 

 5.00 star(s) 

 Aug 29, 2022 

 Version: 0.7.0

 This app is beautiful. The rendered visuals are great and way better than dumping the results screen screenshots into the league chat. It would be neat if you could adjust the size of the text though as the header with the league name is always kinda squished. The stats themselves are very cool and neat for out commentators when not too much is happening on-track (talking about past races, etc..). The only wish I have left is AC support but it seems to be a planned feature so great job man, 10/10 would use again.
